n97cb513f40.headline: Mongolia and EBRD collaborate on solar, wind and energy storage
n97cb513f40.summary: Mongolia is collaborating with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development to promote renewable energy. The work covers solar, wind and energy storage.
n97cb513f40.why: The EBRD is a multilateral development bank that finances energy projects, so its involvement can bring capital and lending to renewable power in emerging markets.

n6681f50972.headline: Russia prepares to supply gas to Transnistria through Türkiye from February, Russian newspaper reports
n6681f50972.summary: Russian gas is likely to be supplied to Transnistria via Türkiye from 1 February, with a section of the TurkStream pipeline reserved for this purpose. The report cites the Russian newspaper Kommersant.
n6681f50972.why: TurkStream is a Russian gas pipeline to Europe through Türkiye, and gas routing changes affect regional energy supply and prices.

n992b9e5c8f.headline: De' Longhi takes over own ordinary shares for nearly EUR2 million
n992b9e5c8f.summary: De' Longhi reported it repurchased 62,416 of its own ordinary shares between January 16 and 17. The shares were bought at an average unit price of EUR31.2575, for a total of nearly EUR2 million.
n992b9e5c8f.why: De' Longhi is an Italian maker of small home appliances such as coffee machines. Share buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding and are a routine capital-management step.

n2867160aa6.headline: BYD announces foray into Salvadoran passenger vehicle market
n2867160aa6.summary: BYD held a brand launch event in El Salvador, marking its official entry into the country's passenger car market. The company announced the move in a press release on January 21.
n2867160aa6.why: BYD is a Chinese electric vehicle and battery maker and one of the largest EV producers globally. Its market entries signal expansion of Chinese auto brands in new regions.

n0d61379c8b.headline: ‘It is unjustifiable’, CNG rejects telecom tariff hike
n0d61379c8b.summary: The Coalition of Northern Groups condemned the Nigerian Communications Commission's approval of a 50% increase in telecom tariffs. The coalition called the increase unjustifiable.
n0d61379c8b.why: The Nigerian Communications Commission regulates telecom tariffs, and tariff changes affect operator revenues and consumer spending on mobile services.

n431fc9b5a3.headline: Czechia installs 967 MW of solar in 2024
n431fc9b5a3.summary: Czechia installed 967 MW of solar in 2024, with residential and commercial and industrial projects accounting for 930 MW, the Czech Solar Association said.
n431fc9b5a3.why: Solar installation volumes indicate the pace of renewable power build-out, which affects electricity supply and demand for solar equipment makers.

n41ecf82636.headline: NSE's total unique investors base crosses 11 crore for first time
n41ecf82636.summary: The total unique investor base on the National Stock Exchange crossed the 11 crore mark for the first time. The milestone was reported from Mumbai on January 22.
n41ecf82636.why: The National Stock Exchange is India's largest stock exchange by volume, and growth in its investor base reflects broader retail participation in equity markets.

n0f9ca129a7.headline: India scrambles to appease Trump amid fears over worker visas
n0f9ca129a7.summary: India is seeking to avoid a trade war with the US by cooperating on the repatriation of illegal migrants, amid fears over worker visas. The effort aims to appease the Trump administration.
n0f9ca129a7.why: US visa policy and trade measures affect India's large IT services and outsourcing sector, which relies heavily on US clients and skilled workers.

n444b249e84.headline: Government’s Gold Board to help stabilise cedi
n444b249e84.summary: The government plans to establish the Ghana Gold Board to regulate small-scale mining. It also aims to revitalise the gold industry, raise foreign exchange inflows and help stabilise the cedi.
n444b249e84.why: Ghana is a major African gold producer, and gold exports are a key source of foreign currency that supports the cedi. Investors track regulatory changes in mining because they affect output and FX earnings.

n7d24665e5f.headline: Donald Trump’s executive orders put EVs, trade agreements in the crosshairs
n7d24665e5f.summary: On his first day as US president again, Donald Trump signed almost 50 executive orders. The orders put electric vehicles and trade agreements in the crosshairs.
n7d24665e5f.why: Executive orders are the fastest tool a US president has to change federal policy, and changes to EV rules and trade deals affect automakers, supply chains and global trade flows.

ne57ee638b1.headline: Greatland Gold makes strong start to ownership of Telfer mine
ne57ee638b1.summary: Greatland Gold said the Telfer mine produced almost 30,000 ounces of gold and more than 1,100 tonnes of copper in the first month of its ownership.
ne57ee638b1.why: Greatland Gold is a mining company that owns and operates gold and copper projects. Monthly production figures are a key indicator of a miner's operating performance and cash flow.

na1b715e853.headline: Farms viability under pressure as incomes fall up to 59pc
na1b715e853.summary: New figures show Welsh farm incomes under intense pressure, with a significant 39% fall in incomes across all but one sector.
na1b715e853.why: Farming incomes shape rural credit demand, land values and food supply costs. Sharp income declines can affect agricultural lenders and food processors.

n3e5cd93525.headline: Under fire Reeves hits back at critics, saying she won't apologise for budget
n3e5cd93525.summary: UK Chancellor Rachel Reeves said she will not apologise for the Budget, arguing critics have offered no real alternatives.
n3e5cd93525.why: The UK Budget sets government tax and spending plans, which influence gilt yields, sterling and business confidence.

nf12e6a7220.headline: World Economic Forum 2025: Carbon markets investor kicks off $1.5 billion Amazon protection plan in Davos
nf12e6a7220.summary: A carbon markets investor backed by Mercuria, working with non-profits, is raising an initial $1.5 billion to protect the Amazon. The plan involves selling rainforest-linked credits and engaging Brazilian states, farmers and communities.
nf12e6a7220.why: Carbon credit markets let companies buy offsets for emissions, and rainforest protection projects are a growing source of investment in that market.

nd9590994ce.headline: MTN, GLO, Airtel and 9mobile data and call plan go cost more after NCC approve 50% tariff hike for telcos in Nigeria
nd9590994ce.summary: Nigeria's Communications Commission has approved a 50% tariff increase for telecom operators, so MTN, Glo, Airtel and 9mobile plans will cost more. The regulator says tariffs have not changed since 2013 despite rising operating costs.
nd9590994ce.why: Telecom tariffs set operator revenue per subscriber, and regulator-approved increases affect the earnings of listed African mobile groups such as MTN and Airtel Africa.

nd55e78c75a.headline: Argentina economic activity seen contracting less in November
nd55e78c75a.summary: Argentina's economic activity likely fell again in November from a year earlier, but by less than the 0.7% contraction in October, a Reuters poll of analysts showed.
nd55e78c75a.why: Argentina's economic activity indicators influence investor views on its recovery, fiscal position and peso-denominated debt.

nddc698b6d9.headline: Some 45,000 Dutch cars affected by Citroën's worldwide recall over faulty airbags
nddc698b6d9.summary: Over 45,000 Dutch Citroën owners must return cars for an airbag fault, according to ANP citing parent Stellantis. Recalled C3 and DS3 models were made between 2009 and 2019.
nddc698b6d9.why: Stellantis is a multinational carmaker that owns Citroën, and recalls can add costs and damage brand reputation.

n6ad8d40ddf.headline: Aldi in-store workers get pay rise to at least £12.71 per hour
n6ad8d40ddf.summary: Aldi is raising pay for in-store workers to at least £12.71 an hour. The increase follows a warning from Aldi UK boss Giles Hurley to the Chancellor about rising taxes.
n6ad8d40ddf.why: Aldi is a major German discount supermarket chain with a large UK business, and wage decisions in the sector shape retail costs and pricing.

n3a01349163.headline: Fortescue shares fall despite record-breaking first half performance
n3a01349163.summary: Fortescue shares fell on Thursday despite a record-breaking quarterly performance. The company is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange under the code FMG.
n3a01349163.why: Fortescue is a major Australian iron ore miner, and its shares are sensitive to iron ore prices and Chinese steel demand.

nbfc4a1ff6c.headline: Borrowing surges to four-year high in blow to Chancellor
nbfc4a1ff6c.summary: The Office for National Statistics said public sector net borrowing stood at £17.8 billion last month, up £10.1 billion on a year earlier.
nbfc4a1ff6c.why: Government borrowing levels influence gilt yields, fiscal policy choices and the Treasury's room for spending and tax decisions.

na25667c8c5.headline: Trump’s offshore wind halt impacts European companies
na25667c8c5.summary: US President Donald Trump's suspension of offshore wind leasing has significantly affected European wind power companies, according to the report.
na25667c8c5.why: Offshore wind developers rely on US leasing and project pipelines, so changes to US policy affect their order books and growth outlooks.

nb583c81192.headline: Procter & Gamble Company (PG) reports earnings
nb583c81192.summary: Procter & Gamble reported earnings in a filing dated January 22, 2025. The source provides no further figures in the brief.
nb583c81192.why: Procter & Gamble is a large US consumer goods maker, and its quarterly results are a closely watched read on consumer staples demand.

n6782fdb87e.headline: Wetherspoon is opening 13 new pubs this year - see full list of locations
n6782fdb87e.summary: Pub chain Wetherspoon will open seven more pubs before the summer, along with four more locations inside Haven Holiday Parks. The article lists the planned locations.
n6782fdb87e.why: JD Wetherspoon is a large UK pub operator, and its estate expansion reflects its growth strategy in the UK hospitality sector.

nfd583f51c8.headline: Stable exchange rate, greater fiscal transparency position Nigeria as 'an attractive investment destination' – Wale Edun
nfd583f51c8.summary: Finance Minister Wale Edun said increased domestic refining capacity, a stable exchange rate and greater fiscal transparency make Nigeria an attractive investment destination.
nfd583f51c8.why: The finance minister leads Nigeria's economic policy, and exchange rate stability and fiscal transparency affect foreign investor confidence in Nigerian assets.

na294bdb334.headline: Telecom operators react to NCC's 50% tariff adjustment approval
na294bdb334.summary: Telecom operators under ATCON have officially reacted to the Nigerian Communications Commission's approval of a 50% tariff adjustment.
na294bdb334.why: Telecom tariffs set by the regulator directly affect operators' revenues and margins, and therefore their equity valuations and investment plans.

n3345e03116.headline: Martin Lewis' MSE says 'last chance' to act now to avoid energy price cap hike
n3345e03116.summary: The UK energy price cap is predicted to rise again soon, and MoneySavingExpert says households should act now to avoid overpaying. The cap sets default household energy tariffs.
n3345e03116.why: The Ofgem energy price cap sets maximum default unit rates for UK households, so changes feed directly into consumer spending and inflation.

nf118944421.headline: Home construction rises but target remains out of reach
nf118944421.summary: Australian home construction is rising, but high costs, labour shortages and low productivity are limiting the sector's ability to build enough new homes.
nf118944421.why: Housing construction activity affects building materials, labour markets and the broader Australian economy, and it influences housing supply policy.

n5accceb025.headline: BPCL announces Rs 5 interim dividend, check record date
n5accceb025.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation has announced an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share. Over the past year it declared equity dividends totalling Rs 10.50 per share.
n5accceb025.why: Bharat Petroleum is a large Indian state-linked oil refiner and fuel marketer, and its dividends matter to income-focused shareholders.

n3f7f241b88.headline: Liberia: CBL Retains 17.0% Monetary Policy Rate
n3f7f241b88.summary: The Central Bank of Liberia's Monetary Policy Committee has retained its monetary policy rate at 17.0%, after assessing global and domestic economic developments.
n3f7f241b88.why: Central bank policy rates set the cost of borrowing in the economy and influence inflation, the currency and lending conditions.

n22e3646540.headline: German beer sales continue to decline in 2024
n22e3646540.summary: Consumption of alcoholic beer in Germany kept falling in 2024, continuing a steady long-term decline, according to the German Brewers' Association.
n22e3646540.why: Germany is Europe's largest beer market, and sustained volume declines affect brewers, pubs and beverage retailers.

n49bf435ca8.headline: Stock market update: Nifty IT index  2.14%
n49bf435ca8.summary: The Nifty IT index, which tracks Indian information technology stocks, closed up or down 2.14 per cent at 42,590.70, according to the report.
n49bf435ca8.why: The Nifty IT index tracks large Indian information technology companies, whose earnings depend heavily on overseas clients, making it a gauge of the sector's health.
n49bf435ca8.why_moved: The index closed 2.14 per cent at 42,590.70, but the input does not state the cause of the move.

n5693219504.headline: US-China Trade War Starts As Trump Imposqes 10% Duty For Fentanyl
n5693219504.summary: Trump announced plans for a 10% tariff on Chinese goods, potentially effective February 1, 2025. The move is linked to concerns over China's role in producing fentanyl precursors.
n5693219504.why: Tariffs on Chinese imports affect US-China trade flows, supply chains and the earnings outlook of exporters and importers on both sides of the Pacific.

source.name: Trak.in - Indian Business of Tech, Mobile & Startups

sources.name: Trak.in - Indian Business of Tech, Mobile & Startups

n5d3ecf7d4d.headline: $1.9m hit in biggest NDIS fine after 'terrible' death
n5d3ecf7d4d.summary: An NDIS provider has been hit with a $1.9 million fine, the highest civil penalty of its kind, over failures linked to a death. The penalty was imposed in Australia.
n5d3ecf7d4d.why: The National Disability Insurance Scheme is a government-funded program, and regulatory penalties affect providers operating within it.

n0fd5b1a741.headline: Germany's beer consumption loses fizz in 2024
n0fd5b1a741.summary: Germany's beer sales for 2024 are expected to be even weaker than in 2023, a year that also saw declines. The figures point to continued softness in domestic consumer demand for beer.
n0fd5b1a741.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and beer sales are a useful read on consumer spending and the domestic brewing sector.

n88693ec61c.headline: Nicola Willis has a new job while she oversees New Zealanders losing theirs – Labour
n88693ec61c.summary: New Zealand's inflation data showed easing, though the Labour opposition said rising rents, rates, insurance costs and high unemployment remain challenges. The political comments accompanied the data release.
n88693ec61c.why: Inflation and unemployment data guide the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's interest-rate decisions and the outlook for the New Zealand dollar.

n05ca6ba6bf.headline: CATL forecasts YoY drop in 2024's revenue, but net profit expected to rise
n05ca6ba6bf.summary: On January 21, CATL announced its 2024 earnings forecast, showing a year-on-year decline in revenue but an increase in net profit attributable to shareholders.
n05ca6ba6bf.why: CATL is one of the world's largest makers of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage, so its results signal demand across the EV supply chain.

nd9d46764ff.headline: Advertisers flee Japan TV channel amid sexual assault claims against star presenter
nd9d46764ff.summary: Advertisers are pulling out of a Japanese TV channel amid sexual assault claims against a star presenter. The scandal has raised questions about the industry's attitude to sexual crimes.
nd9d46764ff.why: Advertising is a major revenue source for Japanese broadcasters, so advertiser withdrawals directly affect station income and corporate governance scrutiny.

n21ad701aa1.headline: Austin rents have fallen for nearly two years. Here’s why.
n21ad701aa1.summary: Rents in the Austin-Round Rock region have fallen for nearly two years, real estate experts and housing advocates said. A large apartment building boom is cited as the driver.
n21ad701aa1.why: Rent levels in major US metro areas feed into inflation measures and the valuations of residential property owners and developers.

n5358e65243.headline: Gujarat plant expansion investment
n5358e65243.summary: Dee Development Engineers has partly commissioned the second phase of its Rs2.5bn ($28.9m) manufacturing facility in Anjar, Gujarat, India.
n5358e65243.why: Manufacturing capacity expansions by mid-sized Indian firms signal capital investment and industrial growth in the country.

n296a67ab81.headline: RBI MPC member Nagesh Kumar advocates two inflation rates for better policy making
n296a67ab81.summary: RBI Monetary Policy Committee member Nagesh Kumar suggested using two inflation measures, one with and one without food prices, to improve rate-setting decisions.
n296a67ab81.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the country's policy rates, and its inflation measures guide those decisions.

ne44663e34a.headline: Netflix raises US prices; is the UK next?
ne44663e34a.summary: Netflix has raised prices on most of its US subscription plans, marking its first price increase for the ad-supported tier. The article asks whether the UK will follow.
ne44663e34a.why: Netflix is a leading global streaming service, and its pricing decisions affect subscriber revenue and the broader streaming market.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: Higher subscription prices on most US plans can lift average revenue per user.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nbf4b526d55.headline: Assessing Trump's claim that U.S. pays 'unfair' share of dues to WHO
nbf4b526d55.summary: While signing the order to end US membership in the World Health Organization, the President spoke of a disparity between US and Chinese contributions. The report explains how WHO funding works.
nbf4b526d55.why: The WHO is funded by member state contributions, and US funding is a major part of its budget. Withdrawal affects global health financing and international institutions.

nd110ba274d.headline: Redwire to acquire Edge Autonomy for $925m
nd110ba274d.summary: Redwire has agreed to acquire US-headquartered uncrewed airborne system technology maker Edge Autonomy in a $925m deal.
nd110ba274d.why: Redwire is a US space and defense technology company, and acquisitions like this typically expand its product portfolio in uncrewed systems.

n037f555edc.headline: Financial Advisor Anticipating Another Cut in Central Bank’s Next Adjustment
n037f555edc.summary: A financial advisor said another interest rate cut could be in the offing next week when the Bank of Canada announces its latest policy decision.
n037f555edc.why: The Bank of Canada sets the policy interest rate that anchors borrowing costs and the Canadian dollar. Rate expectations shape bond yields and currency moves in Canada.

nd4de65557f.headline: Viet Nam plans to complete construction of North-South railway project in 10 years
nd4de65557f.summary: Vietnam plans to complete construction of the North-South high-speed railway project in around 10 years, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh said.
nd4de65557f.why: Large public infrastructure programmes drive demand for construction, steel and rail equipment and shape long-term growth.

source.name: Thời báo Tài chính Việt Nam

sources.name: Thời báo Tài chính Việt Nam

n187d31a003.headline: Germany and Norway: Collaborating for Hydrogen Supply Chains
n187d31a003.summary: Germany and Norway are joining forces to develop clean hydrogen supply chains, aiming to boost energy security and the transition to sustainable energy sources.
n187d31a003.why: Hydrogen supply chains are a key part of the energy transition, and government cooperation can shape investment in production and transport.

n9fdd84c1d5.headline: Sunway Healthcare picks banks for what could be biggest Malaysia IPO in years
n9fdd84c1d5.summary: Sunway has picked banks including HSBC Holdings and Malayan Banking to arrange an initial public offering of its healthcare business, sources said. The deal could be Malaysia's biggest IPO in years.
n9fdd84c1d5.why: Large IPOs signal the health of equity capital markets and can shape valuations of listed healthcare peers in the region.

n0f6e9e9d12.headline: French and German leaders meet to discuss Trump tariff threats
n0f6e9e9d12.summary: Macron and Scholz met at the Elysee Palace to discuss Trump's tariff threats, insisting Europe was strong and the Franco-German partnership solid. Scholz said Trump would be a challenge.
n0f6e9e9d12.why: US tariffs on European goods affect trade flows and corporate margins across the eurozone's largest economies.

n01c5572c69.headline: Trump hits WHO where it hurts
n01c5572c69.summary: America's withdrawal from the World Health Organization has far-reaching implications for global health security, according to the report. The move affects international health funding and coordination.
n01c5572c69.why: The WHO coordinates global health responses, and funding gaps can affect pandemic preparedness and related sectors such as pharmaceuticals.

n05a0ba92a9.headline: Public feedback sought for setting up RTP for unlisted companies at PSX
n05a0ba92a9.summary: Pakistan's Securities and Exchange Commission issued a consultation paper proposing a registration and trading platform for unlisted companies at the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Public feedback is being sought.
n05a0ba92a9.why: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan regulates capital markets, and a trading platform for unlisted firms would widen the pool of investable companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n4d6efac0d5.headline: Trump's tariff threats are 'leverage,' says informal economic advisor
n4d6efac0d5.summary: A long-time informal economic adviser to Donald Trump says recent threats of 25 percent tariffs on Canada and Mexico are a negotiating tactic.
n4d6efac0d5.why: Tariffs on major trading partners affect cross-border supply chains, inflation expectations, and the currencies and equities of exporting economies.

nd8fc1bcb7c.headline: Pakistan's FinMin stresses sustainable growth focused on exports at World Economic Forum
nd8fc1bcb7c.summary: Pakistan's Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb addressed the World Economic Forum in Switzerland, presenting Islamabad's economic progress and focus on exports.
nd8fc1bcb7c.why: The World Economic Forum gathers global policymakers and executives, and a finance minister's remarks signal the country's policy direction to investors.

nf9f74f201d.headline: South Korea’s birthrate set to rise for the first time in nine years - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
nf9f74f201d.summary: South Korea's birthrate is set to rise in 2024 for the first time in nine years, following a rebound in marriages that had been delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic.
nf9f74f201d.why: Demographic trends shape long-term labour supply, consumer demand and government spending plans, all of which matter for investors in Korean assets.

n7281932e2c.headline: Volvo opens Singapore facility to support its electric vehicle ambitions
n7281932e2c.summary: Volvo's new Singapore hub will focus on advanced engineering and technology development for electric vehicles.
n7281932e2c.why: Expanding EV infrastructure and R&D capabilities can influence vehicle production, innovation, and regional competitiveness.
